thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high error rate in serving-runtime-gpu-pool-usw2, NCCL_COMM_TIMEOUT observed, affected jobs: tensor-pipeline-v3 (tp=4)
maria-sre: I’m on it — seeing ~18% requests hitting 504s in the last 2m. NCCL logs show repeated 'ncclCommDestroy' + 'unhandled timeout' on gpu-node-07
dmitri: nvcc/nvidia-driver XID 79 shows in dmesg a few minutes before hangs. nvidia-smi looks OK now but multiple container restarts happened on that node
carla: can we cordon gpu-node-07 and drain? want to avoid more task restarts causing repeated rendezvous failures
maria-sre: cordoning now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-07`
alex: draining with grace 60s, will let jobs failover to spare pool: `kubectl drain gpu-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60`
dmitri: increasing NCCL debug: set env NCCL_DEBUG=INFO on serving-runtime pods to collect better traces before we restart them
ops-bot: action: created ticket INF-4622, added logs + auto-collected tarball at /mnt/log-archive/INF-4622-1769601234.tar.gz
carla: customers impacted: 2% of hosted API requests for a handful of tenants in us-west-2, some saw degraded latency, one reported a failed batch job (retry attempted)
maria-sre: mitigation plan: 1) cordon/drain node-07 2) restart runtime on warmed spare nodes 3) temporarily lower tp pipeline size from 4->2 for new allocations 4) route in-flight live traffic to dedicated fallback variant (tp2-compat)
dmitri: doing step 2: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/serving-runtime` on spare pool, collecting `/var/log/nccl*` and `dmesg` dumps to the ticket
alex: lowering tensor parallel allocation flag on autoscaler: set ENV TP_MAX=2 for new pods, rolling change started
carla: note: lowering TP reduces throughput but avoids cross-GPU rendezvous instability while we triage. ops notified major customers via status page (short message)
maria-sre: observed one more communicator reset after drain began — I attached the excerpt to INF-4622: `ncclCommInitRank failed, NCCL_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION`
dmitri: that string often correlates with mixed driver/firmware versions after live reimage. confirming that gpu-node-07 had a different CUDA driver patch applied yesterday
carla: for immediate recovery we should reroute traffic off clusters with mixed driver state. ops, can you add a routing rule?
ops-bot: routing rule created: `route:exclude=cluster-usw2-mixed-drivers` — applied to hosted API traffic at the edge for new requests.
alex: collecting core/gcore from crashed pod: `kubectl exec -it <pod> -- gcore -o /tmp/core` and copying to log-archive. uploading now
maria-sre: let's capture `nvtop`/`nvidia-smi -q -x` snapshots and full NCCL debug printouts; add as artifacts to INF-4622
dmitri: for postmortem: propose we add a preflight check in node-provisioner that verifies CUDA driver + firmware + NCCL compatibility and quarantines mismatched nodes from the serving pool until reconciled
carla: agreed. also add a regression test to CI that runs a quick 4-GPU collective barrier test on fresh images before adding to pool
maria-sre: ops update: node-07 is drained. error rate dropped to ~1.2% and latency trending down after TP->2 change. still monitoring
alex: starting short canary for tp4 on a clean node image with increased NCCL_DEBUG to validate fix before we scale TP back up
carla: notify customers: status page updated with root-cause as 'multi-GPU collective rendezvous failures due to driver mismatch and node-level flapping', ETA for full recovery TBD after validation
maria-sre: handoff note for next on-call: keep `TP_MAX=2` until we validate 24h of stability and verify all nodes have consistent driver versions. assign INF-4622 to eng-runtime for full triage
dmitri: added diagnostic checklist to ticket: driver versions, kernel modules, dmesg XID logs, core dumps, nccl debug snapshots, pod restart timestamps
incident-bot: incident annotated: severity=sev2, responders=[maria-sre,dmitri,carla,alex], ticket=INF-4622
carla: thanks team. good runbook steps captured — @maria-sre please post brief postmortem once we have root cause confirmed and rollout plan for driver remediation
maria-sre: will do. logging handoff: I'm on-call for another 30m then hand to @dmitri for overnight watch. keeping INF-4622 open
ops-bot: summary created and pinned to thread: `INF-4622: NCCL communicator resets on mixed-driver node -> cordon/drain -> TP fallback -> routing exclusion -> recovery in progress` :white_check_mark:
